design.template_cells: per recipient frame a seeded permutation pi of the 6 direction x gap cells; template j gets cells pi[j] and pi[(j+3) mod 6]; each cell appears exactly twice per frame
design.years: recipient r and retained donor a uniform over valid (r, a) in the cell; the 4 years {r1, a1, r2, a2} of a template's two groups are distinct
design.retained_donor: same template (frame + noun) as the recipient, year a
design.discarded_donors: K = 8 per group, all at the recipient year r; slot k uses donor frame k (8 donor frames, disjoint from recipient frames) and donor noun base[(g + D[k]) mod 48] with D = (0,1,4,9,15,22,32,34) (frozen donor-noun order); every donor context (frame, noun) is used exactly once; the 8 nouns of a group are distinct; each noun is used 8 times; donor nouns are disjoint from recipient nouns
design.Q: uniform empirical distribution over the 8 discarded donor activations of the group; all 8 are enumerated (no sampling)
design.reserved_for_confirmatory: frames and nouns not used by the development assignment are recorded as unused; every development prompt, context and noun is excluded from any confirmatory pool

acceptance.grammar: format, template agreement and tokenization only; semantic naturalness is not checked
acceptance.on_failure: blocks registration; no relaxation and no alternative order/offset/seed search

estimator.s2: s^2 = sum_g w_g ||C_J(F[branch=x_a]) - C_J(F[branch=x_r])||_m^2 over the 48 development groups

budget.clock: starts after model load and an untimed warmup on an old calibration prompt; covers extraction and all group forwards
budget.checks: hard time/memory caps after extraction and after every group (a running forward cannot be pre-empted; the next one is not started); projection elapsed + max(group time) x remaining x 1.25 after the 3rd group; partial raw outputs and controls are kept on any stop
budget.rows_per_group: 16 scientific (8 minus + 8 plus) + 2 natural-scale (x_a, x_r) + 1 duplicate numerical control = 19; extraction = one 19-row canonical forward per logical prompt (480 forwards, 9120 computational rows for 48 groups)

power.streams: dataset j of (N, scenario, hypothesis): data stream (2, iN, iS, iH, j), independent bootstrap stream (3, iN, iS, iH, j); the bootstrap is the confirmatory resampler; one [B, n_t] int16 index array per frame in memory

smoke.data: OLD Day-1 calibration only: manifests/pilot_pairs_calibration.csv (rec, don) and manifests/moment_pool_calibration.csv (same-year discarded donors); recipients alternate between lengths 12 and 14 and same-year donors of both lengths occur (the length mismatches that were padded in v2 mixed extraction)
smoke.warmup: untimed: one extraction forward + one 19-row group forward on old calibration pair 0 (never a smoke group); then exactly 3 timed groups
smoke.legacy_contrast: descriptive only: v2-style mixed right-padded extraction of the same smoke prompts with extra pads 0..4

extraction.rule: every extraction forward = ONE prompt replicated 19 times (no padding, no mixing, mask all 1); the recorded branch input x and the unpatched reference logits are taken from row 17, the identity row of the 19-row group forward (same physical layout); donors get their own canonical forward; no batch-1 extraction
